```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| eval: true

using Pkg
Pkg.activate("../applied-optimization")

# Plots.jl otherwise hands Quarto a finished HTML <img>, which bypasses Quarto's
# figure handling: `#| fig-alt` and captions are dropped on the web page. Without
# the HTML form Quarto receives the SVG and treats it as a figure. Applied once
# Plots is loaded, so pages without plots do not load it.
push!(Base.package_callbacks, pkg -> pkg.name == "Plots" &&
    @eval Base.showable(::MIME"text/html", ::$(Base.loaded_modules[pkg]).Plot) = false)
```
